features.name: oc_specific_empirical_example
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment make a specific counter-argument that cites an empirical example as support?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment makes a specific counter-argument that cites a concrete empirical example (e.g., a particular real-world case, event, study, statistic, or data point) as support, whether the example is the commenter's own or an attributed external source cited as support. Return 0 if no comment does (including a valid empty list). Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Do not count purely hypothetical or abstract examples, generic assertions, or quoted OP text. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Presence only, not count.

h0: Discussions with oc_specific_empirical_example=1 have the same association with OP view change (delta) as those with oc_specific_empirical_example=0.
h1: Discussions with oc_specific_empirical_example=1 are more likely to have OP view change than those with oc_specific_empirical_example=0.
note: Presence interpreted as at least one qualifying comment. Association only, not causal. OC_comments is current text and may contain outcome announcements; timing relative to the OP's view change is unknown, and comment order is not chronology. Linear probability model via OLS.
